name: Echoes from Beyond
descriptionTemplate:
At turn start, draw [Arg1] "Strike" cards with Arithmetica Cost -1. After releasing Exalt, generate [Arg2] "Strike" cards of the corresponding Awakener with {Exhaust}, {Prepare 1}, and {Retain}.
For each [Arg3] "Strike" played within 1 turn, gain [Arg4] Temporary {STR}; after playing [Arg5] "Strike" cards, draw [Arg6] {plural:[Arg6]|card|cards} and gain [Arg7] Arithmetica; after playing [Arg8] "Strike" cards, all Awakeners gain [Arg9] Aliemus.
lore: Echoes mingling in the mist of another world, leading to distortion, madness, and undeniable reality.
